Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Structural biology studies macromolecules in three dimensions. (i) Define structural biology. (ii) Explain how it determines the active sites and domains of macromolecules, with the examples of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase and serine proteases. (4 marks)
(Structural biology macromolecules ka teen-jehti mutaala karti hai. (i) Structural biology ki definition likhein. (ii) HIV-1 reverse transcriptase aur serine proteases ki misalon se samjhayein ke yeh macromolecules ki active sites aur domains kaise maloom karti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Structural biology macromolecules, jaise proteins aur nucleic acids, ki teen-jehti (3D) structures ka atomic satah par mutaala hai. Yeh biomolecule ki structure, kaam, dynamics aur ligands aur doosre macromolecules se raabte ki tafseel deti hai.

(ii) Structural biologists proteins aur nucleic acids ki 3D structures maloom karte hain. Yeh structures active sites aur domains (alag kaam wali alag structural units) ki theek jagah, shakal aur mahol dikhati hain.
• HIV-1 reverse transcriptase: structural mutaale ne is ka polymerase domain pehchana jo DNA banata hai, aur RNase H domain jo RNA-DNA hybrid ka RNA strand torta hai. In domains ki jagah aur structure jaan kar aisi antiviral dawaayein banayi gayin jo khaas inhein nishana banati hain.
• Serine proteases: in ki structure aik wazeh active site dikhati hai jo peptide bonds torne ki zimmedar hai.

book_ref.quote: The 3D structures reveal the exact location, shape, and environment of the active sites

blocks.prompt:
2 Using the example of the coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2), explain how structural biology helps in (i) identifying drug targets and (ii) identifying host–pathogen interactions. (4 marks)
(Coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) ki misaal se samjhayein ke structural biology (i) drug targets pehchanne aur (ii) host–pathogen interactions pehchanne mein kaise madad karti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Drug targets: structural biology bimari wale molecule par woh sahi jagah dhoondti hai jahan dawa kaam kar sake; yeh jagahein aksar proteins hain aur drug targets kehlati hain. In ki 3D shakal parh kar scientists woh khaas jagah dhoondte hain jahan dawa jur kar protein ka kaam rok de. COVID-19 mein scientists ne SARS-CoV-2 ke spike protein ka mutaala kiya jo virus ko insani cells mein dakhil karta hai. Is ki 3D structure jaan kar use drug target banaya aur spike protein ko rokne wali vaccines aur dawaayein banayin taa ke virus mazeed cells infect na kare.

(ii) Host–pathogen interaction pathogens (viruses ya bacteria) ka host ke jism ke cells se raabta hai. Pathogen aur host dono ke proteins ki 3D structures parh kar scientists dekhte hain ke pathogen host cell se kaise chipakta aur andar jata hai aur kaun se molecules shamil hain. Structural biologists ne coronavirus ki satah se bahar nikle spike protein aur insani cells ke us protein ka mutaala kiya jo is ka receptor hai, aur maloom kiya ke virus insani cells mein kaise dakhil hota hai. Is se receptor proteins se jurne wali dawaayein banin; aisi dawa virus aur receptor ka raabta rok kar virus ka host cells mein dakhla band kar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: So, the scientists discovered exactly how the virus enters human cells

blocks.prompt:
3 Protein crystals are the starting material for determining a protein's structure by X-ray. (i) Why must a protein be crystallized, and how are protein crystals prepared? (ii) What happens to a crystal on the X-ray machine? (4 marks)
(Protein ki structure X-ray se maloom karne ke liye protein crystals bunyadi maadda hain. (i) Protein ko crystal kyun banana zaroori hai aur protein crystals kaise tayyar hote hain? (ii) X-ray machine par crystal ke saath kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Protein crystallization saaf kiye gaye protein ko thos crystal ki shakal dena hai. Crystals is liye zaroori hain ke yeh protein molecules ko baqaida dohrai tarteeb mein rakhte hain jo X-ray mein saaf image ke liye ahem hai. Crystal banane ke liye scientists protein ko khaas mahloolon ke saath aahista milate hain jin se molecules tarteeb se jurte hain. Is mein ghante, din ya hafte lag sakte hain aur temperature, pH aur namak ke concentration ka ehtiyaat se control chahiye. Saaf aur mazboot crystal ban jaye to agle qadmon mein istemal hota hai.

(ii) Achha crystal X-ray machine par lagaya jata hai aur mukhtalif zaviyon se us par X-ray beam daali jaati hai. Crystal ke atoms beam ko mor dete hain aur detectors par diffraction pattern, yani nuqton ka silsila, banta hai. Nuqton ke zaviye aur shiddat crystal mein atoms ki tarteeb ki maloomat rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Once a clear and stable protein crystal is formed, it can be used in the next steps

blocks.prompt:
4 Define computational biology and state its importance. Describe its three major areas: genomics, proteomics and bioinformatics. (4 marks)
(Computational biology ki definition aur ahmiyat likhein. Is ke teen bare shobe bayan karein: genomics, proteomics aur bioinformatics.)
blocks.explanation:
Computational biology kayi uloom ka shoba hai jo computational techniques aur tools se biological masail hal karta hai. Yeh biology, computer science, mathematics aur statistics ko mila kar biological data ka tajziya aur tashreeh karta hai. Is ki ahmiyat bare datasets sambhalne, chhupe patterns dhoondne aur paishgoi ke models banane mein hai jo nayi biological samajh dete hain.

1. Genomics: genomes ka mutaala; genome jandaar ke aik cell mein DNA ka mukammal set hai. Is mein genomes ki sequencing, jorna aur un ke kaam aur structure ka tajziya hai; yeh genetic farq, gene ke kaam aur irtiqai rishte samjhata hai.

2. Proteomics: proteins aur un ki structure aur kaam ka bare paimane par mutaala. Is ka maqsad jandaar ke tamam proteins (proteome) ka naqsha banana aur cell ke kaamon mein un ke raabte aur kirdaar samajhna hai.

3. Bioinformatics: biological data sambhalne aur tajziya karne mein computer technology ka istemal. Is ke tools DNA, RNA aur protein sequences ko mehfooz karte, nikaalte aur tajziya karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Major areas in the computational biology include

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the applications of computational biology in drug discovery, genetic research and evolutionary biology. (4 marks)
(Dawaon ki daryaft, genetic research aur evolutionary biology mein computational biology ke istemal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Dawaon ki daryaft: computational biology mumkin drug targets pehchanne aur biological systems par dawa ke asar ki simulation mein madad deti hai. Yeh dawaon ke proteins aur doosre molecules se raabte ki paishgoi kar ke daryaft ko tez karti hai.

2. Genetic research: DNA sequences ke tajziye se yeh bimariyon se juri genetic tabdeeliyan pehchanti hai, bimariyon ki genetic bunyad samjhati hai aur personalized medicine (har mareez ke mutabiq ilaaj) tak le ja sakti hai.

3. Evolutionary biology: computational tools mukhtalif species ki genetic maloomat ka muqabla kar ke irtiqai rishte dobara banate aur evolution ka amal samjhate hain.

Yeh tajziye GenBank (nucleotide sequences), Protein Data Bank (3D structures) aur Ensembl (genome browser) jaise databases aur BLAST aur FASTA jaise algorithms se hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Though computation biology has vast application, some of these are discussed here

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the two key algorithms BLAST and FASTA used in the analysis of biological data. (4 marks)
(Biological data ke tajziye mein istemal hone wale do ahem algorithms BLAST aur FASTA bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. BLAST (Basic Local Alignment Search Tool): bunyadi biological sequences, jaise proteins ke amino acids ya DNA ke nucleotides, ka muqabla karta hai. Yeh homologous sequences pehchanne, na-maloom genes ka kaam batane aur irtiqai rishton ke mutaale mein madad deta hai.

2. FASTA: sequence alignment tool jo aik query sequence ko sequences ke database se mila kar mushabehat ke hisse dhoondta hai. Yeh protein aur nucleotide databases mein talaash, sequence homology pehchanne aur alignments ke tajziye mein kaam aata hai.

Dono tools sequences ka muqabla kar ke mushabehat dhoondte hain; mushtarka ajdaad wali mushabehat (homology) na-maloom genes ke kaam aur irtiqai tareekh ka ishara deti hai.

book_ref.quote: some algorithms being used in data analysis are discussed below

blocks.prompt:
7 Homologous sequences come from a common ancestral sequence. (i) Define sequence homology. (ii) Explain its two types, orthologs and paralogs, and compare them. (4 marks)
(Homologous sequences aik mushtarka asal sequence se aati hain. (i) Sequence homology ki definition likhein. (ii) Is ki do qismein, orthologs aur paralogs, samjhayein aur in ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Sequence homology mushtarka ajdaad ki wajah se DNA, RNA ya protein sequences ki mushabehat hai. Homologous sequences aik mushtarka asal sequence se irtiqa paa kar bani hain.

(ii) Orthologs mukhtalif species ki woh sequences hain jo speciation ke dauran aik mushtarka asal gene se banin; aksar yeh species mein wohi kaam rakhti hain. Paralogs aik hi species ki woh sequences hain jo gene duplication se banin; aik hi asal gene se hone ke bawajood in mein naye kaam paida ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: can be categorized into two main types

rows: Speciation mein mushtarka asal gene se
Naye kaam paida kar sakte hain

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain the significance of sequence homology in evolution, in predicting gene function and in understanding diseases. (4 marks)
(Evolution, gene ka kaam batane aur bimariyan samajhne mein sequence homology ki ahmiyat samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
• Evolution: sequence homology jandaaron ke irtiqai rishton ki samajh deti hai. Homologous sequences ka muqabla kar ke scientists species ki irtiqai tareekh aur un ke alag hone ka andaza lagate hain.

• Na-maloom genes ka kaam: sequence homology na-maloom gene ya protein ke kaam ka ishara deti hai. Agar na-maloom gene ya protein kisi maloom kaam wale ka homologous ho to us ka kaam bhi aksar milta julta hota hai.

• Bimariyan: mukhtalif species mein bimariyon se jure homologous genes pehchanna bimari ka mechanism samajhne aur ilaaj banane mein madad deta hai. Model organisms ke homologous genes parh kar insani bimariyon ki samajh milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Sequence homology provides an insight into the evolutionary relationships between organisms

blocks.prompt:
9 What is structural homology? Explain its importance in predicting protein function, in drug design and in understanding evolution. (4 marks)
(Structural homology kya hai? Protein ka kaam batane, dawaon ke design aur evolution samajhne mein is ki ahmiyat samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Structural homology mushtarka ajdaad ki wajah se proteins ya doosre macromolecules ki 3D structures ki mushabehat hai. Milti julti structure wale proteins aksar milte julte kaam karte hain chahe un ki sequences zyada na milen.

• Kaam ki paishgoi: protein ki 3D structure us ke kaam ki ahem maloomat deti hai, is liye structural homology naye daryaft hue proteins ka kaam batane mein madad deti hai.

• Dawaon ka design: dawaayein aksar khaas protein structures se jurne ke liye banti hain; proteins ke structural rishte samajh kar zyada mufeed dawaayein banti hain.

• Evolution: proteins ki structural homology ka mutaala un irtiqai amal ko samajhne mein madad deta hai jo proteins ke kaam aur raabte banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Understanding structural homology helps in predicting the function of newly discovered proteins
